scope: Post-open confirmatory execution repair on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 virtual-nine roster. Invalid v217 reversed camera packets but omitted the already frozen restoration of labeled observation blocks by camera ID. V217.1 changes only that permutation-sentinel implementation. It preserves every depth, field/metric gate, tolerance, parent, solver, preconditioner, input, and cost rule. K9-through-K15 results are now known from invalid v217 and are not represented as blinded evidence.
scientific_question: After implementing the originally frozen camera-ID restoration exactly, does the same globally fixed K9-through-K16 qualification execute validly, and what lowest single global depth reproduces every absolute and K16-matched gate over all 546 cells and 13 complete rigs?

unread_before_freeze: whether exact camera-ID packet restoration satisfies the unchanged permutation gate
whether the full formal and independent v217.1 executions are valid
whether the already observed invalid-v217 depth pattern reproduces after the execution repair

opened_scope.dataset: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 5
opened_scope.role: already opened post-open deterministic-reference development data only

solver_contract.solver: Unmodified strict PCGLS recurrence with zero initialization, denominator floor 1e-30, and the v215 exact geometry-only Jacobi preconditioner.
solver_contract.preconditioner: Exact diag(A^T A), relative floor 1e-6, median-positive normalization, fixed by reported geometry before observation and truth metrics.
solver_contract.selection_rule: Select the first depth in the fixed global order K9 through K16 that passes every absolute and K16-matched gate over all 546 cells and all 13 complete rigs. The same selected depth applies to every cell, frame, and rig; per-cell, per-frame, or per-rig depth selection is forbidden.
solver_contract.parent_continuity: The newly replayed K8 and K16 fields, metrics, observations, and logical call ledgers must match the sealed v215 geometry-Jacobi PCGLS arms within the frozen tolerances.

matched_accuracy_ratios.denominator: The corresponding replayed geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 metric, with a fixed 1e-30 numerical floor only to reject division by zero.

execution_and_cost_contract.single_checkpoint_trajectory_per_cell: One unchanged PCGLS trajectory runs through K16 and records K8 through K16; candidates are not rerun separately.
execution_and_cost_contract.geometry_setup_disclosure: Exact geometry-Jacobi setup wall and state bytes remain separate from logical online A/A^T. No setup amortization, wall, RSS, or deployment claim is authorized.
execution_and_cost_contract.camera_permutation_sentinels: For frame 0 of each of the 13 rigs, construct a labeled packet of camera IDs and observation blocks, reverse that packet, then stably restore both the reported operator camera order and its observation blocks to the frozen active-camera order by camera ID before replay. The restored IDs and blocks must exactly equal the originals. The inverse diagonal, K16 field, metrics, and selection-relevant quantities must remain invariant within the unchanged 1e-10 tolerance.
execution_and_cost_contract.v217_1_only_permitted_change: Implement the camera-ID restoration that v217 protocol text already required but its runner and validator omitted. No numerical threshold, scientific array, depth, gate, parent, solver recurrence, preconditioner, or data may change.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must not import either v217 or v217.1 formal runner. It must independently parse all 42 raw density fields, rebuild all 13 virtual-nine rigs and exact observations, independently restore reversed labeled camera packets by camera ID, independently build the exact geometry-Jacobi preconditioner, implement PCGLS, recompute K8 through K16 physical fields and four metrics, all absolute and K16-matched gates, the globally selected depth, camera-permutation sentinels, actual A/A^T ledgers, parent continuity, input seals, invalid-v217 evidence seals, and the final decision.

decision_order: Any source or input mismatch, unexpected parent or invalid-v217 status, wrong shape or depth order, non-finite value, parent-continuity failure, call-ledger mismatch, labeled-packet restoration failure, permutation failure, K16 inadequacy, formal-independent drift beyond tolerance, or decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_GLOBAL_PCGLS_DEPTH_QUALIFICATION_V217_1.
Select the first globally fixed K9-through-K16 depth that passes every absolute and K16-matched gate.
If K9 through K15 all fail and K16 passes, conclude PASS_K16_REMAINS_MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_GLOBAL_PCGLS_DEPTH_V217_1.
If one of K9 through K15 passes first, conclude PASS_LOWER_GLOBAL_PCGLS_DEPTH_QUALIFIED_V217_1 and record that unique lowest depth and its logical exact-call reduction relative to K16.
No result authorizes a learned warm start, wall/RSS claim, external generalization, curved-ray claim, or real-BOST claim.

stop_rules.on_k16_minimal: Keep K16 as the adequate deterministic reference. Any future warm initializer must match K16 and strictly reduce both A and A^T; do not weaken the reference or use per-cell depth selection.
stop_rules.on_lower_depth: Freeze the selected lower global depth as the sole deterministic reference for the next initializer gate. Do not choose a deeper or shallower reference after seeing initializer results.
stop_rules.on_inconclusive: Preserve v217 and v217.1 evidence. Do not perform another execution repair unless a new explicit defect is identified independently; do not interpret partial depth values.
stop_rules.always: Do not rescue a failed mechanism with a larger neural model or GPU.
